# Template Shadcn v2.0.0

Modern React template dengan TypeScript, Vite, dan Shadcn/ui.

## 🚀 Quick Start

```bash
# Clone repository ini
git clone https://github.com/BlackCoffeee/template-shadcn.git my-app
cd my-app

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Setup environment
cp .env.example .env.local

# Start development
npm run dev
```

## ✨ Features

- ⚡ **Vite 6.x** - Fast build tool
- ⚛️ **React 18** - Latest React
- 🔷 **TypeScript** - Type safety
- 🎨 **Shadcn/ui** - Beautiful components
- 🎭 **Tailwind CSS 4.x** - Modern styling
- 🌙 **Dark Mode** - Theme switching
- 📱 **Responsive** - Mobile-first
- 🔐 **Authentication** - Complete auth system
- 📊 **Dashboard** - Ready-to-use dashboard

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, Vite
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/ui
- **State**: Zustand
- **Routing**: React Router
- **Icons**: Lucide React

## 📦 Scripts

```bash
npm run dev              # Development server
npm run build            # Production build
npm run build:staging    # Staging build
npm run preview          # Preview build
```
